rightNotes: 33:8 Some Hebrew manuscripts, SP, and Vulgate; see verse 7; most MT manuscripts Hahiroth

units.leftText: They traveled from Marah, and came to Elim. In Elim, there were twelve springs of water and seventy palm trees, and they encamped there.
units.rightText: They set out from Marah and came to Elim, where there were twelve springs and seventy palm trees, and they camped there.

units.leftText: They traveled from Elim, and encamped by the Red Sea.
units.rightText: They set out from Elim and camped by the Red Sea.
rightNotes: 33:10 Or the Sea of Reeds; also in verse 11

units.leftText: They traveled from the Red Sea, and encamped in the wilderness of Sin.
units.rightText: They set out from the Red Sea and camped in the Desert of Sin.
rightNotes: 33:11 The geographical name Sin is related to Sinai and should not be mistaken for the English word sin; also in verse 12.

units.leftText: They traveled from the wilderness of Sin, and encamped in Dophkah.
units.rightText: They set out from the Desert of Sin and camped at Dophkah.

units.leftText: They traveled from Dophkah, and encamped in Alush.
units.rightText: They set out from Dophkah and camped at Alush.

units.leftText: They traveled from Alush, and encamped in Rephidim, where there was no water for the people to drink.
units.rightText: They set out from Alush and camped at Rephidim, where there was no water for the people to drink.

units.leftText: They traveled from Rephidim, and encamped in the wilderness of Sinai.
units.rightText: They set out from Rephidim and camped in the Wilderness of Sinai.

units.leftText: They traveled from the wilderness of Sinai, and encamped in Kibroth Hattaavah.
units.rightText: They set out from the Wilderness of Sinai and camped at Kibroth-hattaavah.

units.leftText: They traveled from Kibroth Hattaavah, and encamped in Hazeroth.
units.rightText: They set out from Kibroth-hattaavah and camped at Hazeroth.

units.leftText: They traveled from Hazeroth, and encamped in Rithmah.
units.rightText: They set out from Hazeroth and camped at Rithmah.

units.leftText: They traveled from Rithmah, and encamped in Rimmon Perez.
units.rightText: They set out from Rithmah and camped at Rimmon-perez.

units.leftText: They traveled from Rimmon Perez, and encamped in Libnah.
units.rightText: They set out from Rimmon-perez and camped at Libnah.

units.leftText: They traveled from Libnah, and encamped in Rissah.
units.rightText: They set out from Libnah and camped at Rissah.

units.leftText: They traveled from Rissah, and encamped in Kehelathah.
units.rightText: They set out from Rissah and camped at Kehelathah.

units.leftText: They traveled from Kehelathah, and encamped in Mount Shepher.
units.rightText: They set out from Kehelathah and camped at Mount Shepher.

units.leftText: They traveled from Mount Shepher, and encamped in Haradah.
units.rightText: They set out from Mount Shepher and camped at Haradah.

units.leftText: They traveled from Haradah, and encamped in Makheloth.
units.rightText: They set out from Haradah and camped at Makheloth.

units.leftText: They traveled from Makheloth, and encamped in Tahath.
units.rightText: They set out from Makheloth and camped at Tahath.

units.leftText: They traveled from Tahath, and encamped in Terah.
units.rightText: They set out from Tahath and camped at Terah.

units.leftText: They traveled from Terah, and encamped in Mithkah.
units.rightText: They set out from Terah and camped at Mithkah.

units.leftText: They traveled from Mithkah, and encamped in Hashmonah.
units.rightText: They set out from Mithkah and camped at Hashmonah.

units.leftText: They traveled from Hashmonah, and encamped in Moseroth.
units.rightText: They set out from Hashmonah and camped at Moseroth.

units.leftText: They traveled from Moseroth, and encamped in Bene Jaakan.
units.rightText: They set out from Moseroth and camped at Bene-jaakan.

units.leftText: They traveled from Bene Jaakan, and encamped in Hor Haggidgad.
units.rightText: They set out from Bene-jaakan and camped at Hor-haggidgad.

units.leftText: They traveled from Hor Haggidgad, and encamped in Jotbathah.
units.rightText: They set out from Hor-haggidgad and camped at Jotbathah.

units.leftText: They traveled from Jotbathah, and encamped in Abronah.
units.rightText: They set out from Jotbathah and camped at Abronah.

units.leftText: They traveled from Abronah, and encamped in Ezion Geber.
units.rightText: They set out from Abronah and camped at Ezion-geber.

units.leftText: They traveled from Ezion Geber, and encamped at Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin.
units.rightText: They set out from Ezion-geber and camped at Kadesh in the Wilderness of Zin.

units.leftText: They traveled from Kadesh, and encamped in Mount Hor, in the edge of the land of Edom.
units.rightText: They set out from Kadesh and camped at Mount Hor, on the outskirts of the land of Edom.

units.leftText: Aaron the priest went up into Mount Hor at the commandment of the LORD and died there, in the fortieth year after the children of Israel had come out of the land of Egypt, in the fifth month, on the first day of the month.
units.rightText: At the LORD’s command, Aaron the priest climbed Mount Hor and died there on the first day of the fifth month, in the fortieth year after the Israelites had come out of the land of Egypt.

units.leftText: Aaron was one hundred twenty-three years old when he died in Mount Hor.
units.rightText: Aaron was 123 years old when he died on Mount Hor.

units.leftText: The Canaanite king of Arad, who lived in the South in the land of Canaan, heard of the coming of the children of Israel.
units.rightText: Now the Canaanite king of Arad, who lived in the Negev in the land of Canaan, heard that the Israelites were coming.

units.leftText: They traveled from Mount Hor, and encamped in Zalmonah.
units.rightText: And the Israelites set out from Mount Hor and camped at Zalmonah.

units.leftText: They traveled from Zalmonah, and encamped in Punon.
units.rightText: They set out from Zalmonah and camped at Punon.

units.leftText: They traveled from Punon, and encamped in Oboth.
units.rightText: They set out from Punon and camped at Oboth.

units.leftText: They traveled from Oboth, and encamped in Iye Abarim, in the border of Moab.
units.rightText: They set out from Oboth and camped at Iye-abarim on the border of Moab.

units.leftText: They traveled from Iyim, and encamped in Dibon Gad.
units.rightText: They set out from Iyim and camped at Dibon-gad.
rightNotes: 33:45 Iyim is another name for Iye-abarim; see verse 44.

units.leftText: They traveled from Dibon Gad, and encamped in Almon Diblathaim.
units.rightText: They set out from Dibon-gad and camped at Almon-diblathaim.

units.leftText: They traveled from Almon Diblathaim, and encamped in the mountains of Abarim, before Nebo.
units.rightText: They set out from Almon-diblathaim and camped in the mountains of Abarim facing Nebo.
rightNotes: 33:47 Or the mountains beyond the river; also in verse 48

units.leftText: They traveled from the mountains of Abarim, and encamped in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.
units.rightText: They set out from the mountains of Abarim and camped on the plains of Moab by the Jordan across from Jericho.

units.leftText: They encamped by the Jordan, from Beth Jeshimoth even to Abel Shittim in the plains of Moab.
units.rightText: And there on the plains of Moab they camped by the Jordan, from Beth-jeshimoth to Abel-shittim. Instructions for Occupying Canaan
rightNotes: 33:49 Or the Meadow of the Acacias; that is, an area in the lowlands of Moab

units.leftText: The LORD spoke to Moses in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, saying,
units.rightText: On the plains of Moab by the Jordan across from Jericho, the LORD said to Moses,

units.leftText: Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, “When you pass over the Jordan into the land of Canaan,
units.rightText: “Speak to the Israelites and tell them: When you cross the Jordan into the land of Canaan,

units.leftText: then you shall drive out all the inhabitants of the land from before you, destroy all their stone idols, destroy all their molten images, and demolish all their high places.
units.rightText: you must drive out before you all the inhabitants of the land, destroy all their carved images and cast idols, and demolish all their high places.

units.leftText: You shall take possession of the land, and dwell therein; for I have given the land to you to possess it.
units.rightText: You are to take possession of the land and settle in it, for I have given you the land to possess.

units.leftText: You shall inherit the land by lot according to your families; to the larger groups you shall give a larger inheritance, and to the smaller you shall give a smaller inheritance. Wherever the lot falls to any man, that shall be his. You shall inherit according to the tribes of your fathers.
units.rightText: And you are to divide the land by lot according to your clans. Give a larger inheritance to a larger clan and a smaller inheritance to a smaller one. Whatever falls to each one by lot will be his. You will receive an inheritance according to the tribes of your fathers.

units.leftText: “But if you do not drive out the inhabitants of the land from before you, then those you let remain of them will be like pricks in your eyes and thorns in your sides. They will harass you in the land in which you dwell.
units.rightText: But if you do not drive out the inhabitants of the land before you, those you allow to remain will become barbs in your eyes and thorns in your sides; they will harass you in the land where you settle.

units.leftText: It shall happen that as I thought to do to them, so I will do to you.”
units.rightText: And then I will do to you what I had planned to do to them.”

units.leftText: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
units.rightText: Then the LORD said to Moses,

units.leftText: “Command the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you come into the land of Canaan (this is the land that shall fall to you for an inheritance, even the land of Canaan according to its borders),
units.rightText: “Command the Israelites and say to them: When you enter the land of Canaan, it will be allotted to you as an inheritance with these boundaries:

units.leftText: then your south quarter shall be from the wilderness of Zin along by the side of Edom, and your south border shall be from the end of the Salt Sea eastward.
units.rightText: Your southern border will extend from the Wilderness of Zin along the border of Edom. On the east, your southern border will run from the end of the Salt Sea,
rightNotes: 34:3 That is, the Dead Sea; also in verse 12

units.leftText: Your border shall turn about southward of the ascent of Akrabbim, and pass along to Zin; and it shall pass southward of Kadesh Barnea; and it shall go from there to Hazar Addar, and pass along to Azmon.
units.rightText: cross south of the Ascent of Akrabbim, continue to Zin, and go south of Kadesh-barnea. Then it will go on to Hazar-addar and proceed to Azmon,
rightNotes: 34:4 Or the Ascent of Scorpions or Scorpion Pass

units.leftText: The border shall turn about from Azmon to the brook of Egypt, and it shall end at the sea.
units.rightText: where it will turn from Azmon, join the Brook of Egypt, and end at the Sea.
rightNotes: 34:5 That is, the Mediterranean Sea, also called the Great Sea; also in verses 6 and 7

units.leftText: “‘For the western border, you shall have the great sea and its border. This shall be your west border.
units.rightText: Your western border will be the coastline of the Great Sea; this will be your boundary on the west.

units.leftText: “‘This shall be your north border: from the great sea you shall mark out for yourselves Mount Hor.
units.rightText: Your northern border will run from the Great Sea directly to Mount Hor,

units.leftText: From Mount Hor you shall mark out to the entrance of Hamath; and the border shall pass by Zedad.
units.rightText: and from Mount Hor to Lebo-hamath, then extend to Zedad,

units.leftText: Then the border shall go to Ziphron, and it shall end at Hazar Enan. This shall be your north border.
units.rightText: continue to Ziphron, and end at Hazar-enan. This will be your boundary on the north.

units.leftText: “‘You shall mark out your east border from Hazar Enan to Shepham.
units.rightText: And your eastern border will run straight from Hazar-enan to Shepham,

units.leftText: The border shall go down from Shepham to Riblah, on the east side of Ain. The border shall go down, and shall reach to the side of the sea of Chinnereth eastward.
units.rightText: then go down from Shepham to Riblah on the east side of Ain and continue along the slopes east of the Sea of Chinnereth.
rightNotes: 34:11 That is, the Sea of Galilee

units.leftText: The border shall go down to the Jordan, and end at the Salt Sea. This shall be your land according to its borders around it.’”
units.rightText: Then the border will go down along the Jordan and end at the Salt Sea. This will be your land, defined by its borders on all sides.”

units.leftText: Moses commanded the children of Israel, saying, “This is the land which you shall inherit by lot, which the LORD has commanded to give to the nine tribes, and to the half-tribe;
units.rightText: So Moses commanded the Israelites, “Apportion this land by lot as an inheritance. The LORD has commanded that it be given to the nine and a half tribes.

units.leftText: for the tribe of the children of Reuben according to their fathers’ houses, the tribe of the children of Gad according to their fathers’ houses, and the half-tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance.
units.rightText: For the tribes of the Reubenites and Gadites, along with the half-tribe of Manasseh, have already received their inheritance.

units.leftText: The two tribes and the half-tribe have received their inheritance beyond the Jordan at Jericho eastward, toward the sunrise.”
units.rightText: These two and a half tribes have received their inheritance across the Jordan from Jericho, toward the sunrise.” Leaders to Divide the Land

units.leftText: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
units.rightText: Then the LORD said to Moses,

units.leftText: “These are the names of the men who shall divide the land to you for inheritance: Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun.
units.rightText: “These are the names of the men who are to assign the land as an inheritance for you: Eleazar the priest and Joshua son of Nun.

units.leftText: You shall take one prince of every tribe, to divide the land for inheritance.
units.rightText: Appoint one leader from each tribe to distribute the land.

units.leftText: These are the names of the men: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
units.rightText: These are their names: Caleb son of Jephunneh from the tribe of Judah;

units.leftText: Of the tribe of the children of Simeon, Shemuel the son of Ammihud.
units.rightText: Shemuel son of Ammihud from the tribe of Simeon;

units.leftText: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Elidad the son of Chislon.
units.rightText: Elidad son of Chislon from the tribe of Benjamin;

units.leftText: Of the tribe of the children of Dan a prince, Bukki the son of Jogli.
units.rightText: Bukki son of Jogli, a leader from the tribe of Dan;

units.leftText: Of the children of Joseph: of the tribe of the children of Manasseh a prince, Hanniel the son of Ephod.
units.rightText: Hanniel son of Ephod, a leader from the tribe of Manasseh son of Joseph;

units.leftText: Of the tribe of the children of Ephraim a prince, Kemuel the son of Shiphtan.
units.rightText: Kemuel son of Shiphtan, a leader from the tribe of Ephraim;

units.leftText: Of the tribe of the children of Zebulun a prince, Elizaphan the son of Parnach.
units.rightText: Eli-zaphan son of Parnach, a leader from the tribe of Zebulun;

units.leftText: Of the tribe of the children of Issachar a prince, Paltiel the son of Azzan.
units.rightText: Paltiel son of Azzan, a leader from the tribe of Issachar;

units.leftText: Of the tribe of the children of Asher a prince, Ahihud the son of Shelomi.
units.rightText: Ahihud son of Shelomi, a leader from the tribe of Asher;

units.leftText: Of the tribe of the children of Naphtali a prince, Pedahel the son of Ammihud.”
units.rightText: and Pedahel son of Ammihud, a leader from the tribe of Naphtali.”

units.leftText: These are they whom the LORD commanded to divide the inheritance to the children of Israel in the land of Canaan.
units.rightText: These are the ones whom the LORD commanded to apportion the inheritance to the Israelites in the land of Canaan.

units.leftText: The LORD spoke to Moses in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, saying,
units.rightText: Again the LORD spoke to Moses on the plains of Moab by the Jordan across from Jericho:

units.leftText: “Command the children of Israel to give to the Levites cities to dwell in out of their inheritance. You shall give pasture lands for the cities around them to the Levites.
units.rightText: “Command the Israelites to give, from the inheritance they will possess, cities for the Levites to live in and pasturelands around the cities.

units.leftText: They shall have the cities to dwell in. Their pasture lands shall be for their livestock, and for their possessions, and for all their animals.
units.rightText: The cities will be for them to live in, and the pasturelands will be for their herds, their flocks, and all their other livestock.

units.leftText: “The pasture lands of the cities, which you shall give to the Levites, shall be from the wall of the city and outward one thousand cubits around it.
units.rightText: The pasturelands around the cities you are to give the Levites will extend a thousand cubits from the wall on every side.
leftNotes: 35:4 A cubit is the length from the tip of the middle finger to the elbow on a man’s arm, or about 18 inches or 46 centimeters.
rightNotes: 35:4 1,000 cubits is approximately 1,500 feet or 457.2 meters.

units.leftText: You shall measure outside of the city for the east side two thousand cubits, and for the south side two thousand cubits, and for the west side two thousand cubits, and for the north side two thousand cubits, the city being in the middle. This shall be the pasture lands of their cities.
units.rightText: You are also to measure two thousand cubits outside the city on the east, two thousand on the south, two thousand on the west, and two thousand on the north, with the city in the center. These areas will serve as larger pasturelands for the cities.
rightNotes: 35:5 2,000 cubits is approximately 3,000 feet or 914.4 meters.

units.leftText: “The cities which you shall give to the Levites, they shall be the six cities of refuge, which you shall give for the man slayer to flee to. Besides them you shall give forty-two cities.
units.rightText: Six of the cities you give the Levites are to be appointed as cities of refuge, to which a manslayer may flee. In addition to these, give the Levites forty-two other cities.

units.leftText: All the cities which you shall give to the Levites shall be forty-eight cities together with their pasture lands.
units.rightText: The total number of cities you give the Levites will be forty-eight, with their corresponding pasturelands.

units.leftText: Concerning the cities which you shall give of the possession of the children of Israel, from the many you shall take many, and from the few you shall take few. Everyone according to his inheritance which he inherits shall give some of his cities to the Levites.”
units.rightText: The cities that you apportion from the territory of the Israelites should be given to the Levites in proportion to the inheritance of each tribe: more from a larger tribe and less from a smaller one.” Six Cities of Refuge (Deuteronomy 4:41–43|DEU 4:41-43*; Deuteronomy 19:1–14|DEU 19:1-14*; Joshua 20:1–9|JOS 20:1-9*)

units.leftText: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
units.rightText: Then the LORD said to Moses,

units.leftText: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you pass over the Jordan into the land of Canaan,
units.rightText: “Speak to the Israelites and tell them: When you cross the Jordan into the land of Canaan,

units.leftText: then you shall appoint for yourselves cities to be cities of refuge for you, that the man slayer who kills any person unwittingly may flee there.
units.rightText: designate cities to serve as your cities of refuge, so that a person who kills someone unintentionally may flee there.

units.leftText: The cities shall be for your refuge from the avenger, that the man slayer not die until he stands before the congregation for judgment.
units.rightText: You are to have these cities as a refuge from the avenger, so that the manslayer will not die until he stands trial before the assembly.

units.leftText: The cities which you shall give shall be for you six cities of refuge.
units.rightText: The cities you select will be your six cities of refuge.

units.leftText: You shall give three cities beyond the Jordan, and you shall give three cities in the land of Canaan. They shall be cities of refuge.
units.rightText: Select three cities across the Jordan and three in the land of Canaan as cities of refuge.

units.leftText: These six cities shall be refuge for the children of Israel, for the stranger, and for the foreigner living among them, that everyone who kills any person unwittingly may flee there.
units.rightText: These six cities will serve as a refuge for the Israelites and for the foreigner or stranger among them, so that anyone who kills a person unintentionally may flee there.

units.leftText: “‘But if he struck him with an instrument of iron, so that he died, he is a murderer. The murderer shall surely be put to death.
units.rightText: If, however, anyone strikes a person with an iron object and kills him, he is a murderer; the murderer must surely be put to death.

units.leftText: If he struck him with a stone in the hand, by which a man may die, and he died, he is a murderer. The murderer shall surely be put to death.
units.rightText: Or if anyone has in his hand a stone of deadly size, and he strikes and kills another, he is a murderer; the murderer must surely be put to death.

units.leftText: Or if he struck him with a weapon of wood in the hand, by which a man may die, and he died, he is a murderer. The murderer shall surely be put to death.
units.rightText: If anyone has in his hand a deadly object of wood, and he strikes and kills another, he is a murderer; the murderer must surely be put to death.

units.leftText: The avenger of blood shall himself put the murderer to death. When he meets him, he shall put him to death.
units.rightText: The avenger of blood is to put the murderer to death; when he finds him, he is to kill him.

units.leftText: If he shoved him out of hatred, or hurled something at him while lying in wait, so that he died,
units.rightText: Likewise, if anyone maliciously pushes another or intentionally throws an object at him and kills him,

units.leftText: or in hostility struck him with his hand, so that he died, he who struck him shall surely be put to death. He is a murderer. The avenger of blood shall put the murderer to death when he meets him.
units.rightText: or if in hostility he strikes him with his hand and he dies, the one who struck him must surely be put to death; he is a murderer. When the avenger of blood finds the murderer, he is to kill him.

units.leftText: “‘But if he shoved him suddenly without hostility, or hurled on him anything without lying in wait,
units.rightText: But if anyone pushes a person suddenly, without hostility, or throws an object at him unintentionally,

units.leftText: or with any stone, by which a man may die, not seeing him, and cast it on him so that he died, and he was not his enemy and not seeking his harm,
units.rightText: or without looking drops a heavy stone that kills him, but he was not an enemy and did not intend to harm him,

units.leftText: then the congregation shall judge between the striker and the avenger of blood according to these ordinances.
units.rightText: then the congregation must judge between the slayer and the avenger of blood according to these ordinances.

units.leftText: The congregation shall deliver the man slayer out of the hand of the avenger of blood, and the congregation shall restore him to his city of refuge, where he had fled. He shall dwell therein until the death of the high priest, who was anointed with the holy oil.
units.rightText: The assembly is to protect the manslayer from the hand of the avenger of blood. Then the assembly will return him to the city of refuge to which he fled, and he must live there until the death of the high priest, who was anointed with the holy oil.

units.leftText: “‘But if the man slayer shall at any time go beyond the border of his city of refuge where he flees,
units.rightText: But if the manslayer ever goes outside the limits of the city of refuge to which he fled

units.leftText: and the avenger of blood finds him outside of the border of his city of refuge, and the avenger of blood kills the man slayer, he shall not be guilty of blood,
units.rightText: and the avenger of blood finds him outside of his city of refuge and kills him, then the avenger will not be guilty of bloodshed,

units.leftText: because he should have remained in his city of refuge until the death of the high priest. But after the death of the high priest, the man slayer shall return into the land of his possession.
units.rightText: because the manslayer must remain in his city of refuge until the death of the high priest. Only after the death of the high priest may he return to the land he owns.

units.leftText: “‘These things shall be for a statute and ordinance to you throughout your generations in all your dwellings.
units.rightText: This will be a statutory ordinance for you for the generations to come, wherever you live.

units.leftText: “‘Whoever kills any person, the murderer shall be slain based on the testimony of witnesses; but one witness shall not testify alone against any person so that he dies.
units.rightText: If anyone kills a person, the murderer is to be put to death on the testimony of the witnesses. But no one is to be put to death based on the testimony of a lone witness.

units.leftText: “‘Moreover you shall take no ransom for the life of a murderer who is guilty of death. He shall surely be put to death.
units.rightText: You are not to accept a ransom for the life of a murderer who deserves to die; he must surely be put to death.

units.leftText: “‘You shall take no ransom for him who has fled to his city of refuge, that he may come again to dwell in the land before the death of the priest.
units.rightText: Nor should you accept a ransom for the person who flees to a city of refuge and allow him to return and live on his own land before the death of the high priest.

units.leftText: “‘So you shall not pollute the land where you live; for blood pollutes the land. No atonement can be made for the land for the blood that is shed in it, but by the blood of him who shed it.
units.rightText: Do not pollute the land where you live, for bloodshed pollutes the land, and no atonement can be made for the land on which the blood is shed, except by the blood of the one who shed it.

units.leftText: You shall not defile the land which you inhabit, where I dwell; for I, the LORD, dwell among the children of Israel.’”
units.rightText: Do not defile the land where you live and where I dwell. For I, the LORD, dwell among the Israelites.”

units.leftText: The heads of the fathers’ households of the family of the children of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of the sons of Joseph, came near and spoke before Moses and before the princes, the heads of the fathers’ households of the children of Israel.
units.rightText: Now the family heads of the clan of Gilead son of Machir son of Manasseh, one of the clans of Joseph, approached Moses and the leaders who were the heads of the Israelite families and addressed them,

units.leftText: They said, “The LORD commanded my lord to give the land for inheritance by lot to the children of Israel. My lord was commanded by the LORD to give the inheritance of Zelophehad our brother to his daughters.
units.rightText: saying, “When the LORD commanded my lord to give the land as an inheritance to the Israelites by lot, He also commanded him to give the inheritance of our brother Zelophehad to his daughters.

units.leftText: If they are married to any of the sons of the other tribes of the children of Israel, then their inheritance will be taken away from the inheritance of our fathers, and will be added to the inheritance of the tribe to which they shall belong. So it will be taken away from the lot of our inheritance.
units.rightText: But if they marry any of the men from the other tribes of Israel, their inheritance will be withdrawn from the portion of our fathers and added to the tribe into which they marry. So our allotted inheritance would be taken away.

units.leftText: When the jubilee of the children of Israel comes, then their inheritance will be added to the inheritance of the tribe to which they shall belong. So their inheritance will be taken away from the inheritance of the tribe of our fathers.”
units.rightText: And when the Jubilee for the Israelites comes, their inheritance will be added to the tribe into which they marry and taken away from the tribe of our fathers.”

units.leftText: Moses commanded the children of Israel according to the LORD’s word, saying, “The tribe of the sons of Joseph speak what is right.
units.rightText: So at the word of the LORD, Moses commanded the Israelites: “The tribe of the sons of Joseph speaks correctly.

units.leftText: This is the thing which the LORD commands concerning the daughters of Zelophehad, saying, ‘Let them be married to whom they think best, only they shall marry into the family of the tribe of their father.
units.rightText: This is what the LORD has commanded concerning the daughters of Zelophehad: They may marry anyone they please, provided they marry within a clan of the tribe of their father.

units.leftText: So shall no inheritance of the children of Israel move from tribe to tribe; for the children of Israel shall all keep the inheritance of the tribe of his fathers.
units.rightText: No inheritance in Israel may be transferred from tribe to tribe, because each of the Israelites is to retain the inheritance of the tribe of his fathers.

units.leftText: Every daughter who possesses an inheritance in any tribe of the children of Israel shall be wife to one of the family of the tribe of her father, that the children of Israel may each possess the inheritance of his fathers.
units.rightText: Every daughter who possesses an inheritance from any Israelite tribe must marry within a clan of the tribe of her father, so that every Israelite will possess the inheritance of his fathers.

units.leftText: So shall no inheritance move from one tribe to another tribe; for the tribes of the children of Israel shall each keep his own inheritance.’”
units.rightText: No inheritance may be transferred from one tribe to another, for each tribe of Israel must retain its inheritance.”

units.leftText: The daughters of Zelophehad did as the LORD commanded Moses:
units.rightText: So the daughters of Zelophehad did as the LORD had commanded Moses.

units.leftText: for Mahlah, Tirzah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Noah, the daughters of Zelophehad, were married to their father’s brothers’ sons.
units.rightText: Mahlah, Tirzah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Noah, the daughters of Zelophehad, were married to cousins on their father’s side.

units.leftText: They were married into the families of the sons of Manasseh the son of Joseph. Their inheritance remained in the tribe of the family of their father.
units.rightText: They married within the clans of the descendants of Manasseh son of Joseph, and their inheritance remained within the tribe of their father’s clan.

units.leftText: These are the commandments and the ordinances which the LORD commanded by Moses to the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.
units.rightText: These are the commandments and ordinances that the LORD gave the Israelites through Moses on the plains of Moab by the Jordan across from Jericho.
